channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: American Truck Simulator - Illinois
item.description: Welcome to the beautiful Prairie State! Illinois showcases the best of what the USA has to offer. Hop into your rig, hit the legendary Route 66, and journey through Springfield, the state’s historic capital, to Chicago, one of the Midwest's most iconic cities.

item.title: HIROTONFA’s American Revolution Smuggler
item.description: Date a state! Buy low, sell high, dodge the Royal Navy and Patriot Privateers, and romance colonial state-chans in a chaotic American Revolution merchant sim. Mercantilism ho!

item.title: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
item.description: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis is a fantasy tower defense strategy game that takes you back in time to the early days of the Kingdom with bold new twists. Build towers, command heroes, and stop Vez’nan’s corruption before it tears the kingdom apart!

item.title: Monastery: Ora et Labora
item.description: Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

item.title: REMATCH - NV Infrared Bundle
item.description: Stock up on Quants and look the part while you're at it.

item.title: Garfield - Escape from Monday
item.description: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

item.title: Tasty Chef
item.description: Tasty Chef is a cozy restaurant management and cooking game where you build and expand unique restaurants, design menus, order ingredients, prepare dishes step by step, hire helpful staff, and serve customers alone or with friends.

item.title: Beast of Reincarnation
item.description: Game Freak's brand-new title: Beast of Reincarnation is an action RPG with a fusion of real-time and turn-based combat. Experience the innovative "one-person, one-dog action RPG" in the beautiful yet harsh world of Beast of Reincarnation. What awaits at the end of Emma and Koo's journey?

item.title: Furyball: Rogue Revenge
item.description: Furyball is a fast-paced action roguelite where your only weapon is a bouncing bullet ball. Control the chaos, shatter enemies, and survive sport-themed arenas inspired by pinball and grindhouse cinema.

item.title: Mystery Egg Shop Simulator
item.description: Run your very own mystery egg shop! Stock shelves, manage customers and grow your business. Open eggs, collect figures, build themed Dioramas , build your own ultimate collection and display your rarest finds. Trade or sell items directly to real players in the player-to-player marketplace!

item.title: Apocalypter
item.description: Apocalypter is a post-apocalyptic, driving, survival, fps, open-world game. Fight, help, trade with different factions. Find different cars and customize them. Scavenge, loot and survive the procedurally generated, open world of Apocalypter.

item.title: Island Restoration
item.description: Island Restoration is a cleaning game where you heal a scarred world, one island at a time. Clean up hazards, rescue cute animals, uncover secrets, and upgrade your tools as you explore diverse regions and transform ever-changing islands into beautiful paradises.

item.title: Necrophosis
item.description: Necrophosis is a first-person horror adventure, plunging you into a nightmarish realm teeming with grotesque forms and ominous visuals. Delve into eerie landscapes and uncover secrets in this atmospheric journey through the macabre.

item.title: Otterly Lost
item.description: Swim, dive, and explore as a curious sea otter far from home. Meet charming animals, discover hidden places, use tools, and solve light challenges as you make your way back with your favorite rock by your side.

item.title: Plan B: Terraform
item.description: Terraform a lifeless rock into a lush and habitable world. Build trucks, trains, and sprawling factories on an enormous hexagonal planet. Grow its population to millions. Enjoy a dynamic simulation of atmosphere, temperature, water, and forests.

item.title: Plan B: Terraform - Worlds of Fire and Water
item.description: Discover a harsh and dangerous volcanic planet, plagued by constant eruptions and extreme heat. Then dive into a fully oceanic world where only a handful of tiny islands await your industry. It's up to you to transform these hostile worlds into new paradises.

item.title: Shadow Warrior 2
item.description: Shadow Warrior 2 is the stunning evolution of Flying Wild Hog’s offbeat first-person shooter starring the brash warrior Lo Wang, who must again wield a devastating combination of guns, blades, magic and wit to strike down the demonic legions overwhelming the world.

item.title: Slow Roads
item.description: Zone out on an endless drive through infinite scenic landscapes. Generate a unique world, set the scene to suit your mood, and just drive...

item.title: Wand & Order: Tidy up the magic shop!
item.description: Cozy first person co-op organizing and cleaning simulator! Sort wands, tarot decks and potions. Tidy up the shop to earn points and unlock powerful spells that help you restore order before the Alchemist returns!
